cart.item: Noisewave N2 Wireless Earbuds with ANC (Charcoal)

concerns.what: Extended warranty add-on (+₹299/item) was offered by default alongside 'No, thanks'; I selected 'No, thanks' since it wasn't requested.
Gift wrap add-on (+₹49/order) checkbox was present but left unchecked.
Cartwheel Plus membership (₹999/year, auto-renewing) was offered; declined via 'No, thanks'.
Express/Next-day delivery upgrades were offered; kept Standard delivery as requested (free, arrives in 4–6 days).
Marketing emails opt-in checkbox present; left unchecked.
